human_actions_pending.context: Phase 1 entry condition: 5-6 physical machines (8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM each) must be available. Managed switch with 802.1Q VLAN support must be configured.

decisions.decision: VLAN 802.1Q (VLAN 10) on managed switch for TARGET network cross-host connectivity
decisions.rationale: Managed switch already available; TARGET VMs on different physical machines need to communicate without internet access

decisions.decision: LVM-thin storage backend, 1 snapshot (clean_state) per VM, ~500 GB/host
decisions.rationale: Proxmox 8.x default, zero RAM overhead, reliable qm rollback; single snapshot keeps thin-pool predictable

decisions.decision: Elasticsearch heap: Xms8g/Xmx8g on elastic-vm (12 GB RAM); CALDERA on caldera-vm (4 GB RAM) — both VMs on the same Proxmox host, never in reset cycle
decisions.rationale: 8 GB heap balances ES with OS page cache; separating CALDERA isolates red team control plane without needing an extra physical machine

decisions.decision: Lab-own CA (elasticsearch-certutil ca); Fleet Server cert SAN: IP:10.0.0.10; CA cert distributed via provisioning script before enrollment
decisions.rationale: Works offline/air-gapped; reproducible; no DNS dependency in Phase 1 before dc01 exists
